Zuckerberg's Net Worth Surges $25 Billion as Meta Stock Rises

Mark Zuckerberg's net worth increased by an estimated $25 billion in one day, driven by a nearly 12% surge in Meta Platforms' stock price. This rally followed Wells Fargo raising its price target on Meta and as investors focused on the company's artificial intelligence (AI) strategy and its new Muse assistant.
